visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female singer with dark hair stands center stage, wearing a sequined black top and a white/green mini skirt. She holds a microphone to her mouth. Behind her, a massive LED screen displays a grayscale close-up of a face with part of a hat visible. Male backup dancers in sleeveless white shirts and white pants move around her in a wide-legged stance. The stage lighting is bright and professionally directed. (2) The background screen transitions to a stark, saturated red color with white rings and geometric shapes. The singer and her troupe of six male dancers perform a synchronized dance routine involving sharp arm movements and low squats. At one point, one of the dancers supports the singer's weight in a lifting motion. The camera perspective is slightly low, looking up toward the elevated stage platform. (3) The visuals on the large background screen change again to show a giant pair of legs wearing high-top boots, towering over the live performers. The singer moves across the stage while continuing to sing into her handheld microphone. The dancers maintain their energetic formations, alternating between flanking the singer and grouping together. The stage environment is vast, with dark floor space visible in the immediate foreground.
